Rainbow-cloaked suit of gilt plate mail, ornate devil helm. Speaks atheist blasphemy, seeding doubt in believers.

AC 15, HP 44, ATK 2 claw (far) +6 (1d6 + WIS drain) or earworm curse, MV near (fly), S +4, D +5, C +4, I +3, W +4, Ch +5, AL C, LV 9

Earworm Curse. Whisper one of the Diabolic True Words to a mortal within close. WIS 18+ or sleep is filled with wretched nightmares. Cannot rest, lose 1d6 WIS permanently (can't heal or rest while cursed). Repeat check each day, become insane and chaotic at 0 WIS.

Impervious. Fire immune. Only damaged by silver or magical sources. WIS Drain. CON 15+ or lose 1d4 WIS permanently. Driven insane at 0 WIS.
